normal.description: Stable resting check-in with adequate available data

exercise.description: Recently exercising with a higher pulse and preserved oxygen

hypoxemia.description: Single usable low oxygen observation with a missing pulse

sensor failure.description: An implausible saturation and a pulse manually flagged by the device

combined deterioration.description: Two successive resting days with low oxygen and elevated pulse; neither value alone is critical

offline.description: Valid resting check-in processed with network and storage access disabled
